newsitem.title: USA: Mobil cuts some crude, natgas output due to storm.
newsitem.headline: Mobil cuts some crude, natgas output due to storm.

text.p: Mobil Corp said Monday it cut some crude oil and natural gas production from a platform in the U.S. Gulf where employees had been evacuated on Sunday ahead of the approaching Tropical Storm Josephine.
"Our facilities are running normally except for Green Canyon, which was evacuated due to high seas and strong winds yesterday," Chris Springham, spokesman for Mobil said.

"We don't have any estimate for the loss," Springham said, adding however that Green Canyon's production was around a gross 20,000 barrels per day (bpd) of crude, and 30 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of gas.
He clarified that not all output may have been cut, and actual volumes affected would only be known later.
Tropical Storm Josephine, currently close to Florida's Gulf Coast with winds around 75 miles per hour, is expected to make landfall in a few hours.
Springham said efforts were being made to return workers to the platform but continuing bad weather may delay their return until Tuesday.
